name: Firebreak
flavor_text: Shine in any situation! Housefires, carfires, arson - you are prepared with our patented coolant mesh. When everything else has been reduced to ashes, you and your pride will remain intact.
effect: Halves heat and fire damage (except lasers). Cannot catch on fire.
mods: Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit, Inconspicuous, Aesthetic

name: Sludge Pump
effect: Increases MT by 1. May be implanted up to 3 times.
mods: Wrongly fitted, Inconspicuous, Perfect fit

name: Tin Arm
effect: The body part won't bleed and can't receive biotech implants or benefit from them.
mods: Cheap, Compartment, Wrongly fitted, Powerful, Tough, Inconspicuous, Perfect fit, Integrated Weaponry

name: Carbonhide
flavor_text: In a world where firepower escalates by the quarter, flesh is a liability - unless it's \emph{AegisDerm}. Bullet, blade, heat, or blunt trauma - AegisDerm absorbs, deflects, and outlasts. No downtime. No exo-rig. No extra weight. Just you, harder to kill.
effect: Can be activated/deactivated during the Declaration Phase. While active, the user has +18 armor but suffers 1 Exhaustion for every hit taken.
mods: Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit, Inconspicuous, Aesthetic

name: Monkey Grip
flavor_text: Unbreakable grip with unending endurance - Toughgrip Climbing Arms are the latest in essential wasteland survival technology. No cliff too high, no peak out of reach.
effect: Grants a +15 bonus to climbing tests and other tests requiring grip strength.
mods: Cheap, Compartment, Wrongly fitted, Powerful, Tough, Inconspicuous, Perfect fit, Integrated Weaponry

name: Deadeye
slogan: One Shot. One Hit. Again and Again.
flavor_text: Eliminate uncertainty with the PRR, our fully integrated ocular augmentation suite built for the sharpshooter, the overwatch, the ghost with a kill list. Targets don’t just fall — they’re pre-defeated.
effect: Aim actions grant an additional +10 to the following shot. Both the shooter and the target can move at any speed and the aim bonus is not lost, as long as it remains visible.
mods: Cheap, Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit

name: Muscle RAM
slogan: The next level of muscle memory.
flavor_text: Never have you been more prepared for everything. NervousPredictor offers improved reaction time in every situation, be it sports, combat, or contract bridge.
effect: Grants +20 to all reaction tests. Enables the user to parry non-primitive ranged weapons. Feinting against the user is twice as effective.
mods: Cheap, Wrongly fitted, Inconspicuous, Perfect fit

name: Cat Legs
effect: Jump and leap distances are doubled. Halves distance for calculation of fall damage when landing in a controlled way.
mods: Aesthetic, Cheap, Inconspicuous, Perfect fit, Powerful, Tough, Wrongly fitted, Compartment

name: L1NC
slogan: Enter the world - become a part.
flavor_text: As the indispensable foundation for total neuro-digital integration, the Level One Neural Connector enables seamless biocircuit access, cybernetic compatibility, and real-time connection to the AR Net. With L1NC, the world doesn’t just appear — it responds.
effect: The user is connected to the global AR network. Most important information is shared through it: Shopping windows, guides, traffic signs, to name a few. People without this implant essentially live in another world, and are generally suspicious within the city. \\ Due to its importance, the L1NC has been optimized to the extreme. It is the safest implant out there, having almost no load on the body. It is also shielded from EMP.
mods: None

name: Lifter Arms
effect: Str for the purpose of determining carry weight, and on tests for slow feats of strength is increased by 40.
mods: Cheap, Compartment, Wrongly fitted, Powerful, Tough, Perfect fit

name: Fear Jail
effect: The character gains the benefits of \emph{Broken}, stacking with the ability. He may never benefit from any positive disposition.
mods: Wrongly fitted, Inconspicuous, Perfect fit

name: Pain Inhibitors
effect: The user suffers no pain or related effects. Due to removal of a natural inhibitor, the character suffers D5-2 dmg to a random location and D5 exhaustion at the end of every day he is active, ignoring injury threshold.
mods: Wrongly fitted, Inconspicuous, Perfect fit

name: Stained Retina
effect: Grants +20 to resist overstimulation like blinding, deafening or pain. While eye-protection is by far the most common, variants exist for hearing, touch and even smell.
mods: Cheap, Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit

name: Junk Arm
effect: The body part won't bleed and can't receive biotech implants or benefit from them. Zone HP is reduced to 20%. As long as the interface is not destroyed, an extremity can be replaced in 15 seconds (5 rounds). \\ Note: most mods are applied to the mount point but some may be applied to the limb instead as per GM discretion
cost: 40 to install the interface; cR 20 per limb
mods: Cheap, Compartment, Wrongly fitted, Powerful, Tough, Inconspicuous, Perfect fit

name: Rayleigh Fibers
effect: Grants +10 to all reaction tests. The character can dodge or parry non-primitive ranged weapons.
mods: Cheap, Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit

name: Reprocessor Stomach
effect: The speed of starvation is reduced to a quarter.
mods: Cheap, Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit

name: Holoskin
effect: Grants -20 to attacks and parries against the user. The user suffers -20 to any tests made to hide while active. It can be activated as an action. \\ It has no effect when wearing armor or thick clothing.
mods: Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit, Aesthetic

name: Prison Disk
effect: The user always has data storage at hand. The connector can be found with a -30 Investigation test - if it is technically possible.
mods: Cheap, Inconspicuous, Perfect fit, Wrongly fitted

name: Snake Eyes
effect: Allows the user to see IR light like heat sources and IR lasers. This may grant +20 to finding hidden people.
mods: Cheap, Inconspicuous, Perfect fit, Wrongly fitted

name: Voice Makeup
effect: Vocal Deceive, Intimidate or Performance tests gain +20.
mods: Cheap, Inconspicuous, Perfect fit, Wrongly fitted

name: Steelbones
effect: Grants 6 armor to the location. Swimming tests suffer a -15 penalty and weight is increased by 10%.
mods: Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit

name: Compound Eyes
effect: Grants the user +30 to tests against being ambushed or surprised. The user's control area increases to 270°.
mods: Cheap, Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit

name: Extradextrous Arm
effect: The user gains +10 Dex, -10 Str and +20 to tactile perception using this arm.
mods: Cheap, Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit, Powerful, Tough, Inconspicuous, Integrated Weaponry

name: Rubber Bones
effect: Grants +20 to most acrobatics checks and all tests to squeeze through small spaces or out of grapples. The user suffers -10 to resist getting knocked down. The zone's HP are halved.
mods: Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit, Tough

name: Gills
effect: Allows the character to breathe under water.
mods: Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit, Inconspicuous

name: Gyro Legs
effect: The character can now stand up in half the time (an action turns into a free action), won't fall over by himself and gains a +20 bonus to resist being knocked over. However he can no longer wear normal shoes.
mods: Cheap, Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit, Powerful, Tough

name: Eagle Eye / Sniffer
effect: Grants +20 to perception tests using one particular sense. The user suffers -20 to tests resisting overstimulation (like blinding, deafening or pain).
mods: Cheap, Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit, Inconspicuous

name: Metabolism Booster
effect: Once per day, if the character is not already malnourished or starving, the character may take 15 minutes of rest to gain natural healing and restore 2D5 exhaustion. The user will become extremely hungry afterwards and take a -20 penalty to most actions until he gets a meal.
mods: Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit

name: Mucus Gland
effect: The character gains 3 temporary HP on every zone, which don't contribute to degradation when lost. When they are lost, it takes a minute for them to regenerate. The user suffers the effects of Bane: Terrible Odor and Bane: Ugly.
mods: Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit

name: Oxygen Tanks
effect: The user's exhaustion threshold is doubled.
mods: Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit

name: Pheromone Glands
effect: Grants +20 to all friendly social tests - the bonus is +40 instead in enclosed rooms without airflow. If either the target or the user wears vac-sealed armor, the augment has no effect.
mods: Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit, Inconspicuous, Aesthetic

name: Wasteland Skin
effect: Grants +40 to tests to resist radiation poisoning and +30 to tests against getting shocked. The user's augments are immune to EMP.
mods: Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit, Inconspicuous, Aesthetic

name: Shadow Runners
effect: Sound-related penalties on sneaking tests are halved, at least reduced by 10.
mods: Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit, Tough, Powerful, Inconspicuous

name: Steelwire Nerves
effect: Increases RI by 1. May be implanted up to 3 times.
mods: Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit

name: Tenadermis
effect: Grants +6 natural armor. It impairs all sense of touch, inferring -10 to tactile Perception tests.
mods: Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit, Inconspicuous, Aesthetic

name: Toxin Filters
effect: The user becomes immune to almost all toxins. This includes the detriments of any chems.
mods: Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit, Tough, Inconspicuous

name: Flash Clone Arm
effect: A lost or broken body part is restored back to normal. \\ It is possible to grow an exact clone. This takes very long (\sim 4 months) but does not use any MT.
mods: Cheap, Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit, Powerful, Tough, Integrated Weaponry

name: Cut Gunk Tank
effect: All bleeding is stopped the moment it begins. Chems last twice as long. These effects, as well as half the implant’s load, are inhibited by most common anesthetics.
mods: Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit
